title: Fix Wrong Ticket Assignment in Zoho Desk #Shorts
description:
Stop misrouted support tickets in Zoho Desk. Learn how to refine your assignment rules using specific criteria like department and subject so tickets reach the right expert every time.

1. Go to Setup › Automation › Assignment Rules
2. Add criteria based on ticket category
3. Assign to specific agent or round-robin queue

Daily Zoho fixes - follow @GSXAutomation

This video uses an AI-generated presenter and voice.

#Shorts #ZohoCRM #Zoho #BusinessAutomation

angle.problem: Tickets are being assigned to the wrong agents automatically.
angle.solution: Refine 'Assignment Rules' using specific criteria like 'Department' or 'Subject'.
steps: Go to Setup > Automation > Assignment Rules
Add criteria based on ticket category
Assign to specific agent or round-robin queue
angle.result: Tickets reach the right expert every single time.
angle.hook: Are your support tickets going to the wrong agent?

lines.say: Click the gear icon for Setup, open Automation, and click Assignment Rules.
